issue_context.title: Update values not getting replaced in 0.1.0 alpha4
issue_context.body:
Its about postgresql, I don't know if same applies for other drivers.
When doing .update using query builder, the values from provided object literal don't get replaced with arguments. So for example if I do .update({ something: true }) then in the query it ends up as something=:updateset__something instead of something=$1, also the "true" isnt present in arguments array.

I will try to investigate it further.
comments:
Created a PR for this, it was related to typo in QueryBuilder.ts.
Also added a test.

review_comments: What does ! mean in the statement `this.expressionMap.updateSet![key];`

when strict typescript compiler option enable it does not allow to access properties of objects without `if` check if it can be undefined. Here we explicitly tell compiler that `updateSet` cannot be undefined by using `!`
